package.description: Quick scan utility for any USB storage device to detect fraudulent or deliberately missing storage.

en-US.description: Quick scan utility for any USB storage device to detect fraudulent or deliberately missing storage.
en-US.longDescription: ValiDrive performs a quick, random-sequence spot-check across the drive's entire declared storage space. At every location it verifies the successful storage and retrieval of random (unspoofable) test data.
en-US.name: ValiDrive, freeware by Steve Gibson
